Consider the matrices A and B above. By applying three matrix elementary column operations

  1. C1:=…
  2. C3:=C3−3C2
  3. C4:=…
each of the form Ci:=Ci+kC2, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the missing elementary column operations?

a

b
C1:=C1−2C2 and C4:=C4−4C2
c
C1:=C1−4C2 and C4:=C4+2C2
d
C1:=C1+2C2 and C4:=C4+4C2
e
C1:=C1+4C2 and C4:=C4+2C2
